key_patterns: Stdlib only. Every write goes through kblib/io.safe_write (allowlist; protected dirs raise SafeWriteError -> CLI exit 5). JSON via io.dumps_json / io.dumps_jsonl (sort_keys, ensure_ascii False, indent 1). Determinism: no wall-clock values in generated files except build_stamp.json and the two stamp-line prefixes; sort every list. Engine version constants (classify.FC_VERSION, nearmiss.NM_VERSION, replay.RP_VERSION, claims.CL_VERSION) are recorded in build_meta.engine_versions; bump a version when its semantics change (cache invalidation). All git calls go through kblib/gitio.git(repo, *args, scope='main-ro'|'main-worktree'|'worktree', eol, odb, alt) verb allowlist. Replay worktrees live in %TEMP%\gkb_<pid>_<hex>\ and are torn down by ReplayEngine.__exit__; CloneGuard snapshots clones before/after. Paths stored POSIX relative to G (paths.rel_posix); markdown renders Windows paths. Tests: synthetic trees under tmp_path with monkeypatch.setenv('GKB_GEMMA_ROOT', ...); slow/real-data tests in tests/test_slow_facts.py read the built KB. Static safety tests scan module source for forbidden APIs (exec/eval, os.kill, mutating git verbs) - follow that style for 'no kernels push' and 'no subprocess git outside gitio'.
